description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC Controller class for handling shipping packaging management in an e-commerce admin panel. It includes endpoints for displaying and saving shipping packaging configurations, interacting with shipping services and rendering views.

classes.name: ShippingPackagingController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller managing shipping packaging settings in the admin interface, including display and save operations, with security authorization.

methods.name: displayShippingPackaging
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the current shipping packaging configuration page.

methods.name: saveShippingPackaging
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save or update the shipping packaging configuration.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Utility method to set up the menu context for the admin interface.
